newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX Hub natgas called up ahead of warmer temps.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX Hub natgas called up ahead of warmer temps.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natgas futures were expected to open slightly higher Thursday ahead of warmer weather across most of the U.S., market sources said.
September over-the-counter trade ranged from $2.17 to $2.175 after settling Wednesday at $2.161 per million British thermal units.
Early Thursday cash prices at the Henry Hub were talked a bit firmer at $2.19-2.22 with the warmer forecast.
On ACCESS, September scored gains after AGA reported a lower-than-expected storage injection figure. It last traded 1.5 cents firmer to $2.176, just shy of the $2.181 session high.
AGA said U.S. gas stocks rose last week by 60 bcf, well below average estimates of 75-85 bcf.
Overall stocks are still 162 bcf, or 9.5 percent above year-ago levels.
Chart traders pegged resistance at $2.19-2.20 and then at $2.26-2.27. Traders said support was at $2.08 and then at last week's low of $2.045.

In Wednesday's cash, August Gulf Coast gas firmed a few cents to the mid-to-high teens. August Midcon was up a couple of cents to $2.07-2.10. New York city gate gas for next month was little changed in the low-$2.40s.
